assets.title: 사진 한 장 카카오톡 공유
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished square 1536x1536 Korean service-announcement image for the travel-photo website Ikkyee (이끼), part 1 of a coordinated three-image series. Not a contact sheet.
Primary subject: sharing ONE travel photo to KakaoTalk, clearly distinguish a single-photo share from a whole album.
Art direction: polished contemporary Korean digital-product editorial, warm near-white solid background #f9f7f2, deep teal #245457 headings, crisp white interface surfaces, very restrained shadows, vivid real-looking travel photography, a small vivid Kakao yellow #fee500 accent. Lots of breathing room, sophisticated and clean, no decorative blobs, no gradient background, no stock marketing people.
Composition: generous safe margins. Top quarter has elegant Korean sans-serif typography, left aligned. Exact large heading in two lines: "사진 한 장으로" / "장소를 나눠보세요". Smaller single-line supporting copy: "마음에 드는 사진을 카카오톡으로".
Central/lower scene fills most of the canvas: two large beautifully rendered smartphone interface mockups, nearly front-facing with very slight opposing angles. Left phone shows an Ikkyee photo detail screen, one beautiful sharp photograph of a sunlit Busan seaside footpath, turquoise sea, coastal greenery, no people. Small text wordmark "Ikkyee" in a refined serif, then "이끼" in Korean; show a familiar share icon near the photo. A short simple teal connector arrow leads to right phone. Right phone is an unmistakable restrained KakaoTalk-style chat scene with pale blue chat background, yellow outgoing message accent and ONE link-preview card containing THE EXACT SAME seaside photograph as on the left. The preview has readable text "이끼에서 만난 한 장면" and a bottom action "사진 보기". Do not show several photos or an album grid in this image. No personal names, addresses, avatars of real people, unread badges or fabricated messages.
Small bottom footer wordmark text "Ikkyee  이끼". Do NOT invent, draw, modify or add a brand symbol; wordmark only. No watermarks, no QR code, no step numbers, no extra copy, no gibberish, no excessive rounded card decoration. This is a conceptual product illustration for an announcement, not a literal screenshot. Prioritize clear feature communication and highly legible exact Korean text.

assets.title: 여행 앨범 공유
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished square 1536x1536 Korean service-announcement image for the travel-photo website Ikkyee (이끼), part 2 of a coordinated three-image series. Not a contact sheet.
Primary subject: sharing an ENTIRE TRAVEL ALBUM to KakaoTalk, visually distinct from sharing one photo.
Match this series art direction: warm near-white solid background #f9f7f2, very large bold dark teal #245457 Korean sans-serif title in the top left, crisp white interface surfaces, very restrained soft shadows, vivid realistic travel photos. Two large black slim-bezel smartphones side by side, almost front-facing with slight opposing angles, lower edges softly fading into the warm-white footer. Minimal teal curved arrow between devices. A small serif "Ikkyee" wordmark with Korean "이끼" centered in the bottom footer. No invented brand symbol, no decorative blobs, no gradient background.
Exact main headline in two lines: "여행의 장면을" / "함께 나눠보세요".
Exact smaller supporting text: "사진과 장소가 담긴 앨범을 공유해보세요".
Left smartphone: Ikkyee album detail screen with small serif wordmark "Ikkyee" and Korean "이끼" in its header, prominent album title "부산에서 보낸 이틀", a small share icon beside title. Show a spacious, well-aligned grid of SIX clearly separate photographs from one Busan trip: sunlit coastal path, turquoise sea with a distant bridge, colorful hillside village, seaside cafe window, quiet harbor, pastel dusk beach. Photograph grid should be the dominant visual inside this phone, clearly communicate a whole collection rather than a single-image view. Simple two-column grid, no tiny illegible captions.
Right smartphone: restrained KakaoTalk-style chat interface with pale blue chat background, yellow outgoing bubble with exact text "우리 여행, 여기 모았어". Beneath it is ONE rich-link preview card: a large vivid seaside cover photo matching the first photograph in the album on the left, then readable title "부산에서 보낸 이틀", small label "이끼 여행 앨범", and a wide action "앨범 보기". Do NOT put a collage into the link-preview card: the album share uses a SINGLE cover photograph. Familiar simple chat input row at the bottom, restrained yellow send icon.
Maintain generous outer safe margins and legibility when viewed on a phone. No faces or personal data, no fake reviews, no invented extra features, no QR code, no watermark, no step number, no gibberish. Conceptual product illustration, not a literal screenshot. Refined editorial promotional graphic with sharp text.

assets.title: 한 번의 여행을 앨범으로 만들기
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished square 1536x1536 Korean service-announcement image for the travel-photo website Ikkyee (이끼), part 3 of a coordinated three-image series. Not a contact sheet.
Primary subject: turning the photographs from ONE TRIP into ONE BEAUTIFUL TRAVEL ALBUM. NOT sharing in a messenger this time.
Series art direction: warm near-white solid background #f9f7f2, large bold deep teal #245457 Korean sans-serif heading at top left, crisp white UI surfaces, subtle realistic soft shadows, bright real-looking travel photography, refined minimalist Korean digital-product editorial. Keep generous outer margins and text sharply legible on mobile. No gradients, orbs, mascots, or decorative plants.
Exact headline in two lines: "한 번의 여행을" / "하나의 앨범으로".
Exact smaller supporting line: "사진을 고르고, 이름과 이야기를 남겨보세요".
Central lower illustration: a premium nearly front-facing slim laptop, sufficiently large that its screen interface is readable, very slight perspective, with a thin keyboard/base visible. Laptop screen shows a clean Ikkyee ALBUM CREATION page inspired by a restrained real website. Header uses only serif text wordmark "Ikkyee" with "이끼" in Korean, NO invented brand symbol. Page heading "앨범 만들기", dark teal upper-right button "앨범 저장". Workspace is two columns: narrow left column with field label "앨범 이름" and filled value "부산에서 보낸 이틀", then label "설명" with a short natural readable sentence "바다를 따라 걷던 주말". Wider right column label "담은 사진", an orderly three-column grid of SIX sharp travel photographs that clearly belong to the same trip: sunny Busan coastal walking path, turquoise sea and a distant bridge, colorful hillside village, seaside cafe, quiet fishing harbor, dusk beach. This is a curated travel album, not random unrelated stock pictures.
Outside the laptop at its lower-left edge, show three modestly sized physical photo prints, slightly fanned but cleanly separated, matching three of the photos INSIDE the album, suggesting memories collected together. A single thin simple teal arrow points from the small stack toward the album screen. No mouse cursor or drag-and-drop instruction. These are supporting objects; the actual album creation interface must dominate and be unobscured.
Footer centered text wordmark "Ikkyee  이끼". No message bubbles, no KakaoTalk panel, no unread badges, no step numbers, no QR code, no watermark. No claims about automatic AI album creation. No invented interface functions. Scene is a conceptual product illustration for a service announcement, not a literal screenshot. Ensure each title and all text is correct Korean.
assets.editPrompt:
Edit this existing square Ikkyee announcement image with one very narrow change.
Remove ONLY the four small navigation texts in the upper-right portion of the laptop's website header: "여행", "사진", "커뮤니티", and "마이페이지". Leave that upper-right header area clean white. Those menu labels do not match the real website.
Preserve absolutely everything else: entire square composition, the two-line Korean headline, supporting sentence, background color, wordmarks, all photographs, the laptop size and position, keyboard, loose photo prints, arrow, album input fields, "앨범 만들기", "담은 사진", and "앨범 저장" button. Do not redraw or redesign the image. No extra text, symbols, logos or changes.
